cues.text: In the command room on the dorm's fourth floor, you sit around the low table with Akihiko, Yukari, Mitsuru, Fuuka and Junpei; Mitsuru sits with her arms folded. Ikutsuki comes in through the door and walks over to stand before you all.
Ikutsuki takes a seat with the group.
Mitsuru's face falls, and she says nothing. Yukari turns to look at her.
